notes.title: 1.0.1 bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which some enemies were taking over the strength of the arena.
Fixed a problem with blinking backgrounds on the third level.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Streaming and Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After a long journey of development and polishing, the time has finally come! ASTLIBRA Revision will be released on October 13th, 2022.

To celebrate the release date announcement, we are currently participating the Steam Next Fest. and plan to run a featured streaming event, showing off some contents that is not included in the public demo.

Feel free to download the public demo and have a try! Let us know your feedback by joining our Discord Server, or in the Steam Discussions.

Have fun!
